name: oc-ad-bye-pass
description: Ad blocker for Chrome, Edge and Orion (iPhone included). Strips YouTube ads out of the video data before the player sees them.

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:orion
scripts.test:all: npm run check && npm test && npm run build:all && npm run verify && playwright test
scripts.zip: npm run build && npm run verify && cd dist && zip -qr ../oc-ad-bye-pass.zip . && cd .. && echo 'oc-ad-bye-pass.zip'
